scope: Source/convention/tolerance guidance for actual future selected R36 workers. Does not append frontier, reserve budget, grant review or qualify a product.

immutable_input.row_order: NPZ order, no sorting/subsetting; retain all unique IDs
immutable_input.frame: outward ICRS J2000 n; z_CMB is released metadata, not proof of a complete observer-frame correction

contract.operator: d=10^((dmzp-25)/5) Mpc; y=c*z_CMB km/s; X=d*[1,n,STF(n*n)]; sigma=hypot(250,70*(ln10/5)*d*e_dmzp); w_k=exp(-0.5*((z-zk)/.012)^2)/sigma^2. Thin QR of sqrt(w)X gives A_k=R^-1 Q^T diag(sqrt(w)); stack in centre order into 36x35970. Units A=Mpc^-1, theta=km/s/Mpc.
contract.critical_nuisance_resolution: The original saved theta4x9 has NO method projection: nuisance treatment is identity. Export this A_raw first. The separate H03_MEAN_GAUGE has Z=d*onehot(method), four nuisance columns, joined rank12 and projected theta rank8. Export its whitened projector or an explicitly named projected identifiable response only as a separate product; it cannot reproduce the original 36 raw coefficients or furnish an anchored monopole. No R26 14-nuisance/K_fact substitution.
contract.leading_physical_response: For a stipulated additive radial-velocity perturbation at fixed d,w,n, R=I_N and N=n_J2000; response [A_raw N,-A_raw N] for constant source bulk and observer velocity. Only their difference is identified; null vectors (h,h). A change of redshift/windows/distance/aberration is a separate full estimator derivative.
allowed_new_execution: Read exact cache; construct/export four fixed QR row operators or equivalent streamed blocks only once; apply A to saved y and sigma for parity.
Do not call run_h03.compute/main: it also reruns 4 baseline fits, method/patch/north sensitivity banks. Reuse saved sensitivity outcomes. Export construction is not a new selected-model fit.
Retain A_raw, source IDs/config, 36-vector, 36x36 covariance, AN, separate nuisance representation and compact parity receipt; no N-by-N covariance.

predeclared_tolerances.justification: Inherited QR/SVD source guard is1e-8; saved differences are2.89e-14 and3.09e-14. Four saved design conditions4.13,4.66,6.98,13.98 are moderate. Float64 accumulation over35970 rows has gamma_N about8e-12; 1e-9 covariance relative and1e-10 absolute allow platform contraction variation while remaining far below saved covariance min eigenvalue0.00101644. These are numerical replay criteria, not physical uncertainties.

minimal_controls: Exact source hash and row identity; A_k X=I9; A y parity; A diag(sigma²) A^T parity including nonzero cross-window blocks.
Compare AN against every saved 9x3 bulk response and A(d*n) against dipole selector; opposite-sign observer columns must not gain rank.
Separate gauge test: monopole=sum four method columns, joined rank12/projected rank8; no arbitrary anchored parameter estimate.
Fail one deliberately permuted-source-row/unchanged-A fixture; require covariance PSD within 64*eps*36*matrix_scale roundoff, no material clipping.
contract.stop: Immutable input mismatch or parity failure; retain first outcome. Missing empirical CF4 law does not block this exact deterministic export.
